text: BAM share fell 0.05 percentage points over 25 hours and 0.04 percentage points over 7 days, to 33.9%. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-1-tee holds 22.6% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. The 65 top-node leadership changes in the window are best read as whale-driven routing, not a structural rollover; the validated rollover was in fra on 2026-06-24, with 22 minutes of early warning.
